summary: Verified frontend patch installing global capture-phase click listener for WhatsApp CTAs in /app/frontend/src/lib/analytics.js (installWhatsAppClickListener) and its mount from AnalyticsRouteTracker. Behaviour-level verification via a live wrapper around window.gtag on the preview URL confirms: (a) whatsapp_click fires exactly once when any anchor with href^='https://wa.me/' is clicked, (b) source is sourced from data-testid and page from window.location.pathname, (c) clicks that originate on nested children inside the <a> still resolve to the anchor via parent traversal, (d) the listener is truly idempotent — after home→catalog→home navigation a single WA-anchor click yields exactly ONE whatsapp_click gtag event, (e) non-WA anchors (e.g. href='/catalog') do NOT trigger the event. All acceptance-criteria for the patch itself are met. HOWEVER, the requested end-to-end verification on real production CTAs could NOT be executed because on the preview build NONE of the target WhatsApp CTAs are actually rendered as wa.me/ anchors — this is a preview data/config issue, not a code issue in the patch.

ui_bugs.issue: Rendered as <a href='/'> (or Link to='/') on the homepage — the CMS-driven heroSecondaryHref is not a wa.me URL in the preview env, so the global listener has nothing to match. Button labelled 'CHAT ON WHATSAPP' but href='/'. Verify content_home.secondary_cta_link seed value.
Rendered with href='#' on /contact in preview. Likely because settings.whatsapp_number is empty/missing so waGeneralLink() returns ''. Listener cannot fire on '#'.

Component correctly guards `if (waLink)` — because settings.whatsapp_number is missing in preview the entire floating WA button is NOT rendered (element absent from DOM on every page). Also NOTE: actual testid is 'floating-whatsapp-btn' not 'floating-btn-wa' as referenced in the review request.
Target testid `custom-lighting-cta-wa` not present in DOM in preview. No wa.me anchor on the page.
Target testid `architects-designers-cta-wa` not present in DOM in preview. Only a 'Discuss a project' internal CTA is visible.

integration_issues.issue: Patch itself is correct — synthetic wa.me anchor click reliably fires window.gtag('event','whatsapp_click',{source, page}). But no real user CTA on the preview environment currently has an href starting with https://wa.me/, so in the preview build the event will still not fire in practice. Root cause: settings.whatsapp_number is unset (backend Settings collection) and/or homepage CMS heroSecondaryHref is '/' rather than a wa.me URL. Fix requires seeding settings.whatsapp_number and updating content_home secondary_cta_link.

action_items: Populate `settings.whatsapp_number` in the backend Settings collection for the preview/prod environment. Without it, waGeneralLink() returns '' and FloatingActions never renders and all *-wa-btn CTAs get href='#'.
Update content_home.secondary_cta_link (and secondary_cta_external flag) so the homepage hero 'CHAT ON WHATSAPP' button renders as <a href='https://wa.me/...'> instead of href='/'.
Confirm content is seeded on /custom-lighting-bulk-orders and /architects-interior-designers with proper wa.me URLs on data-testids `custom-lighting-cta-wa` and `architects-designers-cta-wa`.

Fix testid mismatch in the review-request text: the actual floating action button uses data-testid='floating-whatsapp-btn' (not 'floating-btn-wa'). The listener labels its source from that testid — GA4 dashboards / event filters should be updated accordingly.
critical_code_review_comments: installWhatsAppClickListener() implementation is clean and correct: (a) module-level `_waListenerAttached` flag makes it idempotent under hot-reload / double-mount, (b) capture-phase document listener works even if child handlers call stopPropagation, (c) anchor lookup traverses parents so icon/span clicks still register, (d) href regex `^https://(www\.)?wa\.me/` correctly excludes non-WA links, (e) source falls back to data-source then 'unknown' if data-testid absent, (f) page uses window.location.pathname which is correct for SPA context.

Existing explicit trackWhatsAppClick calls in Cart.jsx line 140 and FloatingActions.jsx line 59 remain and WILL cause a duplicate event fire for those two specific CTAs (explicit + global). Review request acknowledges this and notes GA4 dedupes/accepts it. Consider removing the explicit calls to simplify — the global listener already covers them — but this is a code-quality nit, not a bug.
The `page` param is capped to 60 chars in trackWhatsAppClick — should be fine for typical routes but could truncate very long product slugs; verify on longest live URL.

success_rate.frontend: Patch code: 100% (5/5 behavioural checks pass). Live-CTA e2e: 0% (blocked — no wa.me anchors rendered on preview)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The global whatsapp_click listener works — verified via synthetic anchor injection on the running preview. To e2e-verify real CTAs the settings.whatsapp_number must first be seeded and content_home secondary_cta_link set to a wa.me URL. After that, click each of: [data-testid='hero-wa-btn'], [data-testid='floating-whatsapp-btn'], [data-testid='contact-wa-btn'], [data-testid='custom-lighting-cta-wa'], [data-testid='architects-designers-cta-wa'], [data-testid='whatsapp-btn'] (on /product/:id), and cart WA CTA — wrapping window.gtag and observing calls with args[1]==='whatsapp_click'. Do NOT rely on Network tab filter for 'collect' — the preview build's gtag stub may not flush requests during headless automation; wrapping gtag directly is reliable.
rca of the issue: Patch is functionally correct. The 'whatsapp_click' event will fire in production the moment (a) settings.whatsapp_number is populated so FloatingActions renders its wa.me anchor and (b) hero/contact/custom-lighting/architects CMS entries point their secondary CTA hrefs at https://wa.me/... URLs. No frontend code change required. Reproduction: on preview homepage, run `document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="https://wa.me/"]').length` in DevTools → returns 0. Mitigation: seed the missing CMS/settings fields.
